clue.text: Sounds like a country off the hot side of Turkey. It is!

definitions.text: Sounds like a country off the hot side of Turkey. It is!

parts.words: Sounds like a country off the hot side of Turkey. It is!
parts.note: the fat that runs off a hot roast turkey has a name that is said just like a nation, and that nation really does lie off Turkey's sunny western coast

explanation.surface: A riddle about the drippings of a roast turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: The pun plays on 'Turkey' as both the bird and the country: the drippings from a hot turkey are said like the country that lies just west of Turkey across the Aegean, and 'It is!' says the pun is literally true too.
explanation.definitionFit: Greece is the nation lying across the Aegean Sea to the west of Turkey.

clue.text: One employed by a cabinet-maker

parts.note: a cabinet-maker reads as a furniture craftsman, but here it is the Prime ... who forms a government cabinet and appoints its members

explanation.surface: A joiner's workshop hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A government member of the cabinet is appointed by the Prime Minister, the person who makes the cabinet.

clue.text: Concerning two put right

parts.note: re is a short word meaning concerning or about
a pair is two of something

explanation.surface: Something about two items being fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: To mend something is to put it right again.

clue.text: Cut away from the river to avoid a scorched-earth policy!

definitions.text: Cut away from the river to avoid a scorched-earth policy!

parts.words: Cut away from the river to avoid a scorched-earth policy!
parts.note: a channel cut away from a river carries water to farmland so it does not dry out, the parched ground being the scorched earth

explanation.surface: A military retreat cut off from the river to avoid destroying the land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scorched-earth policy' suggests war, but here it just means letting fields bake dry; cutting channels from a river prevents that.
explanation.definitionFit: To water farmland by channels drawn from a river or reservoir is to supply it artificially with water.

clue.text: A hundred a girl the shape of this pungent cooking aid

indicators.note: the letters are bent into a new shape, signalling a rearrangement of a girl together with the numeral

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Someone loves a strong-smelling ingredient a hundred times over.
explanation.definitionFit: This bulb is a strongly flavoured seasoning used widely in cooking.

clue.text: Flying fish eater

parts.note: reads as a predator of the flying fish, but means a fish-eater that flies, a large seabird that dives for its prey

explanation.surface: A predator that dines on flying fish.
explanation.definitionFit: This large white seabird plunges from the air to catch fish.

clue.text: Among their varieties are cultivated black seed

definitions.text: Among their varieties are cultivated black seed

parts.words: Among their varieties are cultivated black seed
parts.note: cultivated (cultured), black and seed are all names of kinds of the gems formed inside oysters, though they sound like farming terms

explanation.surface: A gardener describing kinds of seed, some cultivated and some black.
explanation.definitionFit: Cultured, black and seed are recognised kinds of these lustrous gems grown inside oysters and mussels.

clue.text: Hurry, bearing a reproduction

parts.note: S, for south, is a compass bearing
a print is a reproduction of a picture

explanation.surface: Rushing while carrying a copy of a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: To dash at full speed is to rush or hurry.

clue.text: The value placed on the head of state?

definitions.text: The value placed on the head of state?

parts.words: The value placed on the head of state?
parts.note: the price on a ruler's head suggests a bounty, but the precious things placed on a monarch's head are the regalia gems

explanation.surface: A bounty on a ruler's head.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the crown, sceptre and other jewelled regalia worn by a sovereign.

clue.text: Off-shore part of the country!

parts.note: off-shore suggests out at sea, but here it means away from the shore, the land inland from the coast

explanation.surface: A stretch of a nation lying out at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The inland region of a country, far from its coasts, is its heartland.

clue.text: Animal conservation unit where perch may be found

definitions.text: Animal conservation unit where perch may be found

parts.words: Animal conservation unit where perch may be found
parts.note: perch suggests a fish in a tank, but it is a roost for birds in a large enclosure

explanation.surface: A wildlife centre's fish tank.
explanation.definitionFit: A large enclosure for keeping birds, fitted with perches for them.

clue.text: Best and worst!

definitions.meaning: to best someone is to beat them
to worst an opponent is to get the better of them, beat them

explanation.definitionFit: To beat or overcome an opponent; best and worst are both verbs for this.

clue.text: Part of the cloth isn't commonly used by a brave fighter

parts.note: the warp is the set of lengthwise threads in woven cloth
ain't is the colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: A piece of fabric that is not in common use by a soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: A brave is a Native American warrior; the face colours he wore for battle are the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Face paint daubed on by Native American warriors before battle, used by a brave going to fight.

clue.text: His head used to ring-from the lord's laughter?

definitions.text: His head used to ring-from the lord's laughter?

parts.words: His head used to ring-from the lord's laughter?
parts.note: his head rang because of the bells on his cap, and his living came from making the lord of the castle laugh

explanation.surface: A man whose head rang from his master's mocking laughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval household clown who wore a belled cap and amused the lord's hall.

clue.text: No longer fashionable to use this word

definitions.text: No longer fashionable to use this word

parts.words: No longer fashionable to use this word
parts.note: describes a word that has dropped out of use, and the term for such a word is itself the description

explanation.surface: A style guide warning against an old-fashioned word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something out of date and no longer in use, as a word fallen from the language is.

clue.text: Those who fear to seem foolish try to put something by on the side

definitions.text: Those who fear to seem foolish try to

parts.note: to save is to put money or goods by for later
a face is one side of a solid shape

explanation.surface: Cautious people keep some savings set aside.
explanation.definitionFit: To avoid humiliation or keep one's dignity is what the idiom means, the aim of anyone dreading looking a fool.

clue.text: Generally run by a boy

parts.note: run suggests a business managed by a lad, but it is a small task done by running about, as by a messenger boy

explanation.surface: A firm usually managed by a young lad.
explanation.definitionFit: A short trip to deliver or collect something, traditionally given to a messenger lad.

clue.text: Take off and plunge down a little way

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece is written below the first

parts.note: to dive is to plunge
St is the short form of street, a way

explanation.surface: A swimmer strips off and dives a short distance down.
explanation.definitionFit: To strip or remove something, as clothes from oneself, is to take it off.

clue.text: Annoyed lover, we hear, will have a quarrel

parts.note: cross means annoyed

indicators.note: says the next word is taken as spoken, not as written

parts.note: a beau is a lover or boyfriend

explanation.surface: A jealous suitor is bound to start an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quarrel' looks like an argument, but a quarrel is also the square-headed bolt shot from this weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval weapon firing short bolts called quarrels, so it is the thing that holds one.

clue.text: He wants a lot for his money!

definitions.text: He wants a lot for his money!

parts.words: He wants a lot for his money!
parts.note: wanting a lot suggests greed, but a lot is an item in an auction that a person offering money hopes to win

explanation.surface: A greedy customer demanding value for money.
explanation.definitionFit: A person making offers at an auction for an item on sale.

clue.text: He suffers from another six hundred — it turns to a thousand

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral for six
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: the word it turns about so it is read backwards

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A sufferer counting his losses into the thousands.
explanation.definitionFit: A person harmed by someone else's actions is a sufferer at another's hands.

clue.text: Work for an American family

parts.note: suggests a job as a domestic for a US household, but means the daily household tasks, a word used especially in America

explanation.surface: A job advertisement for a nanny in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Routine household jobs such as washing up and cleaning.

clue.text: Cried out like one with a vocation

definitions.meaning: having a strong sense of a calling, as to the priesthood

explanation.definitionFit: Shouted aloud, or summoned by a calling to a religious life.

clue.text: The Socialists finished what remains

parts.note: the left is the socialist side of politics
over means finished or ended

explanation.surface: The Labour movement is a spent force.
explanation.definitionFit: Food or anything left unused after a meal is a remnant.

clue.text: Hesitate with indecision to speak the French word to describe a female

parts.note: dit is French for says or speaks
her is the pronoun used for a woman

explanation.surface: Someone hesitating over which French word to use for a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: To waver and be unable to make up one's mind.

clue.text: Stress it's of little account, such a small sum

parts.note: a/c is the short form of account
a cent is a tiny sum of money

explanation.surface: Something so trivial is hardly worth mentioning.
explanation.definitionFit: Emphasis placed on a syllable or word is its stress.
